text: But OLED screens | have no backlight.
The secret is hidden | inside the lid.
Behind the display | sits a light source | built just for the logo.
Four tiny LEDs | create the entire glow.
iFixit found them | along one edge.
A reflective layer | bounces their light,
and it shines | through the whole logo.
The result? | One evenly lit logo, | with no screen backlight needed.
It even dims and brightens | with the light in your room.
And one Terminal command | switches it off.
